checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] Last detected HANA Update in CCDB: within last 12 months
checkitem.compliant: NAME = 'VERSION' and VALUE like '%' and CD_HIST_MOD like '%' and TO_DATE(CD_HIST_DATE) >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP,-365)
checkitem.noncompliant: NAME = 'VERSION' and VALUE like '%' and CD_HIST_MOD like '%' and not TO_DATE(CD_HIST_DATE) >= ADD_DAYS(CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP,-365)

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] Security Maintenance Status of HANA SPS Version (see Note 2378962)
[p1-CRITICAL] CRYPTOLIB date not older than 365 days
checkitem.compliant: KEY = 'crypto_provider_version' and HOST like '%' and not DAYS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_REGEXPR('([A-Za-z]{3} [0-9]{1,2} [0-9]{4})' IN (REPLACE(VALUE, ' ', ' 0'))), 'Mon DD YYYY'),CURRENT_DATE) >= 365
checkitem.noncompliant: KEY = 'crypto_provider_version' and HOST like '%' and DAYS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_REGEXPR('([A-Za-z]{3} [0-9]{1,2} [0-9]{4})' IN (REPLACE(VALUE, ' ', ' 0'))), 'Mon DD YYYY'),CURRENT_DATE) >= 365

checkitem.compliant: KEY = 'crypto_provider_version' and HOST like '%' and VALUE like_regexpr '^CommonCryptoLib (8\.5\.39|8\.5\.[456789]\d|8\.[6789]\.\d+|8\.\d{2,}\.\d+)[ ].*'
checkitem.noncompliant: KEY = 'crypto_provider_version' and HOST like '%' and not VALUE like_regexpr '^CommonCryptoLib (8\.5\.39|8\.5\.[456789]\d|8\.[6789]\.\d+|8\.\d{2,}\.\d+)[ ].*'
